meta.title: Ilia Gurevich — real estate agent in Budva | GUREVIĆ
meta.description: Ilia Gurevich is the founder of the DOO GUREVIC BUDVA real estate agency and the agent you work with in person. Our third year on the Montenegrin market.

h1: Ilia Gurevich and the GUREVIĆ agency
lead: A real estate agency in Budva run by its founder. You deal with one person — from your first question to the signing of documents.

portrait.name: Ilia Gurevich
portrait.role: Founder and agent, DOO GUREVIC BUDVA
portrait.alt: Ilia Gurevich, founder of the GUREVIĆ real estate agency in Budva

who.title: Who you will be working with
who.p1: Ilia Gurevich is the founder of DOO GUREVIC BUDVA and a real estate agent. The agency's phone, WhatsApp and Telegram are his personal contacts, so you deal with him directly at every stage.
who.p2: Work outside an agent's role — legal checks, design and construction — is done by partners: lawyers and licensed architects and builders. We introduce you to them and hand over the matter together with everything we have gathered.

market.title: Our third year in Montenegro
market.p1: The agency is in its third year on the Montenegrin property market. Our main focus is Budva and the Budva Riviera; the catalogue also includes properties in other towns across the country.
market.p2: The catalogue on this website is updated automatically from the agency's working database. Confidential investment opportunities are published in anonymised form.

format.title: A new way of working
format.intro: The agency now works in a new format. In practice this means the following.

directions.title: Four separate directions
directions.text: Buyers, tenants, investors and owners have different goals. That is why each of them has a section of the website, questions and an enquiry form of their own.

agreements.title: Written agreements
agreements.text: Terms of work are set out in a written agreement under Montenegrin law — before the work starts, not along the way.

partners.title: Partners for specialist work
partners.text: We provide initial legal support ourselves. In-depth legal checks, design and construction are handled by lawyers and licensed specialists — work outside the agency's role is handed over to them.

honest.title: Known facts only
honest.text: We tell you what is known about a property: documents, condition, terms. Preliminary figures are labelled as preliminary and subject to verification.

languages.title: Languages
languages.text: We advise in Russian, English and Montenegrin. The website is available in more languages, but correspondence and meetings are held in one of these three.

cta.title: Tell us what you are looking for
cta.text: Send a message in your preferred messenger or give us a call. The services page describes what exactly we can help with.
